notes: Ethereum COLLECTION launch of Worker Frens (wFREN), maximum 2222 on-chain pixel frens, using the accepted source unchanged. Deploy PlaceFrens (src/FrensPlacement.sol, no arguments), then PlaceModules (same file, one address argument: $contract:PlaceFrens). PlaceFrens creates FrenPrices and IMD6900Frens; PlaceModules creates FrenSwapper, FrenMinter and FrenWorkerGate. FrensPlan fixes the team wallet 0x35dA9C0303507ddf708E87F2568EdDf12c47a059 as collection owner and governor and gate owner. The price table, swapper and minter have no owner/governor role; the factory and placement contracts retain no role. Keeper, relayer and job payee remain the pinned FrensPlan values. Both launch constructors are nonpayable and take no owner argument. Deployment is one transaction with zero ETH and no factory initialization calls. test_EachLaunchFitsOneTransaction measures about 12.45M gas including calldata and launcher overhead, with at least 1M gas spare below 2^24. The accepted creation code in src/FrensCode.sol and salts in src/FrensPlan.sol use the standard CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C: collection 0x6900d042460d6bdbe68CE994F4dE36706797CCd4, swapper 0x69002297DD7980af0d24249f6a44E7046B1Cb1fb, minter 0x46B50a3061Ea692e075231c13bc653FdD1Bedd29, gate 0xF83807Ec2E27e1771Fb2594139c1F6925Cfd9B8E, prices 0x8f135B75Df156e6346c8525E138bC2BD652146ff. These CREATE2 addresses are independent of the launch caller. Existing deployments are reused. If a pre-placed swapper's seeded average is outside the 2x spot band, PlaceModules creates a replacement using plain CREATE; read PlaceModules.swapper(), and arrange that replacement's timelock fee exemption. On a fresh chain without the standard deployer, placement uses its own CREATE2 and addresses differ. The ART launch is separate and already live (IMD launch 1067): WorkerFrensRenderer 0x0a2e5e0c1d00fe63ab4e391c052a023cc7a16292. After deployment, the team wallet runs script/frens/DeployFrens.s.sol setup() with MODULES set to this launch's PlaceModules and RENDERER set to that live renderer. This owner-operated setup is outside the manifest deployment.
